title: New Song Spotlight
description: This week's spotlight is Dave Matthews Band's "Gravedigger" — a stark, whispering story-song that pulls a crowded room into utter silence. From DMB's 2003 solo record Some Devil, it trades DMB's big-band sunshine for a single acoustic guitar and Dave's hushed parlor voice, telling the tales of the dead through the hands that bury them. In a Djembe set it lands as a dark, dramatic centerpiece — a deep breath of mortality that hangs in the air long after the last word.
songListNote: Song of the Week — Dave Matthews Band's hushed story-song "Gravedigger" joins the request catalog this week.
